blocks.text: The reactions of amines come from the lone pair of electrons on the nitrogen atom, which lets them act as bases and as nucleophiles. This section covers their basicity (24.3.1), how nitrous acid distinguishes primary, secondary and tertiary amines (24.3.2) and the reactions of phenylamine (24.3.3).

blocks.prompt: Which feature of an amine molecule explains both its basicity and its nucleophilic behaviour?
blocks.explanation: The lone pair of electrons on the nitrogen atom.

items: The N lone pair makes amines bases and nucleophiles.
